proposals.title: Proposal 9 - Give Each Share An Equal Vote
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the Board initiate a recapitalization plan giving one vote per share for all outstanding stock, including negotiating with Class B holders to relinquish preexisting voting rights.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal 10 - Stockholder proposal regarding an annual sustainability report
proposals.topic_summary: Requests Facebook issue an annual sustainability report on short- and long-term responses to ESG issues, including greenhouse gas emissions, water, and energy, by December 2016.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal 11 - Stockholder proposal regarding a lobbying report
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report disclosing company lobbying policies, direct and indirect lobbying payments, trade association memberships, and board oversight of such payments.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal 12 - Stockholder proposal regarding an international public policy committee
proposals.topic_summary: Requests establishment of a board International Public Policy Committee to oversee policies on international public issues including human rights, corporate social responsibility, and charitable giving.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal 13 - Stockholder proposal regarding a gender pay equity report
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report by October 2016 on Company policies and goals to reduce the gender pay gap, including the percentage pay gap and quantitative reduction targets.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal.
